title: Course Feedback
instructions: Thank you for taking the course. Tell us how far you agree with each statement about it, then how easy the course portal was to use and how likely you are to recommend the course. Choose "Not applicable" for anything you did not use.

items.text: The course met its stated goals
The pace of the course was right for me
Feedback on my work was timely and useful
The lab sessions helped me apply what I learned
How likely are you to recommend this course to a colleague?

comment.prompt: Is there anything else you would like to tell the instructors?
